as_written_in_papers.quote: The panel detected the presence of two novel compound heterozygous mutations in the LPIN2 gene: I716Vfs*2 (c.2144_2145dupGT) and p. E565Kfs*15 (c.1693_1694delGA) frameshifts.

cases.statement: One affected girl of Italian (central-European) ancestry from non-consanguineous parents, compound heterozygous with c.2144_2145dup (PMID 39255247).

people.label: patient (single case)
people.key_phenotypes: onset at 6 months with elbow swelling and low-grade fever; multifocal STIR hyperintensity of long bones; microcytic anaemia with dyserythropoiesis on bone marrow; splenomegaly and lymphadenopathy; no skin involvement

quotes.quote: The girl, first child of non-consanguineous Caucasian Italian parents, at the age of 6 months presented swelling of the right elbow associated with low-grade fever.

The blood tests confirmed microcytic anaemia (Hb 10 g/dl, mean corpuscolar volume (MCV) 65 fl) with leucocytes and platelets within the normal range, increased inflammatory markers (CRP 8.59 mg/dl, ESR 43 mm/1 h, serum amyloid A 702 mg/l) and hypergammaglobulinemia.
The whole-body MRI detected similar bilateral findings in the radius, ulna, astragalus and metatarsus bones, with involvement of the surrounding soft tissue (Fig. 1A and B).
A bone marrow aspirate showed increased trilinear cellularity with ineffective erythropoiesis and signs of dyserythropoiesis: binuclear/trinuclear erythroblasts and inter-nuclear bridging (Fig. 1D).
Multiple lymphadenopathies and splenomegaly were also detected.

phenotype_specificity.statement: Early-onset multifocal sterile osteomyelitis with dyserythropoietic microcytic anaemia; no skin lesions. She had a large autoinflammatory/immunodeficiency NGS panel; the paper does not state results for other genes.

quotes.quote: In light of the clinical picture, a large next-generation sequencing (NGS) diagnostic panel for autoinflammatory diseases and immunodeficiencies was performed.
In view of the clinical picture, the genetic and functional data, the diagnosis of Majeed syndrome was pointed out.

segregation.statement: No other affected relatives reported. Father carries this variant; mother carries the other. Parents' clinical status is not described.

quotes.quote: The first mutation, at exon 16, was inherited from the mother, while the second, at exon 12, was inherited from the father.

de_novo.statement: Not de novo: inherited from the father. Both parents were tested. Parentage confirmation is not reported.

quotes.quote: The first mutation, at exon 16, was inherited from the mother, while the second, at exon 12, was inherited from the father.

in_trans.statement: Other allele c.2144_2145dupGT (I716Vfs*2) from the mother. Phase was shown by parental testing; Sanger confirmed.

quotes.quote: The first mutation, at exon 16, was inherited from the mother, while the second, at exon 12, was inherited from the father.
The mutations were confirmed by Sanger analysis.

functional.statement: Assay on the patient's own monocytes, which carry both variants, so it is not specific to this one. IL-1β secretion after LPS was faster than in 3 healthy donors and fell after anakinra.

quotes.quote: As shown in Fig. 2A, the kinetics of the IL-1β secretion is much faster in the patient (black square) than in healthy monocytes [health donors (HD)] (white circle).
After 3 months of treatment with anakinra, patient monocytes secreted less IL-1β (Fig. 2A).

variant_type_and_mechanism.statement: A 2-bp deletion causing a frameshift, p.(Glu565LysfsTer15) (from the batch HGVS; it agrees with the paper). The authors expect truncation or nonsense-mediated decay; loss-of-function disease.

quotes.quote: while c.1693_1694delGA creates a new reading frame that ends with a stop at position 15 after the mutation
Both variants are expected to produce a truncated protein or, more likely, to lead to early degradation of mRNA through the mechanism of nonsense-mediated decay.
Majeed syndrome is an autosomal recessive monogenic autoinflammatory disease caused by loss-of-function mutations in the LPIN2 gene.

population_data_in_papers.statement: Absent from INFEVERS, gnomAD, 1000 Genomes and dbSNP per the authors.

quotes.quote: The mutations detected in our patient are not reported in the INFEVERS database [16] or in other human sequence databases (gnomAD, 1000 Genomes Project, dbSNP).
Both variants were classified as pathogenic variants (PVS1-PM2-PP4) according to the ACMG guidelines [17].

concerns: The functional assay is not specific to this variant (the patient has both variants).
The paper writes the protein change as 'p. E565Kfs*15' (with a space) and the cDNA as c.1693_1694delGA. No transcript is named; exon 12 is the authors' numbering.
A different nearby variant, c.1691_1694delGAGA (a 4-bp deletion), appears in the review table of PMID 41113563 (rows K1, O1). It is not this variant; the panel should not merge the two.
The parents' phenotypes are not described.
Same person also carries candidate G-majeed-007 (c.2144_2145dup).

notes_for_panel: A single compound heterozygous case (the same girl as G-majeed-007) with phase set by parental testing. The authors state ACMG criteria. The c.1691_1694delGAGA variant in other patients is a different allele.
